g.text: 48 of 254 Texas counties raised their total rate from 2021 to 2025 and 11 held it;

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #333333

g.text: the largest rise was Jeff Davis, +58.7 cents per $100

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #777777

g.text: County total property tax rate, dollars per $100 of valuation. Open dot 2021, blue dot 2025; label = change in cents per $100.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #777777

g.text: Sorted by size of change, largest first.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #777777
